newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso down as cenbank buys $20 million.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso down as cenbank buys $20 million.

text.p: Colombia's peso fell 0.35 to 1,001.45 to the dollar on Friday, declining for the eighth consecutive session as the central bank bought up at least $20 million, interbank traders said.
"The greenback is still under heavy pressure and the central bank bought at least $20 million to prop it up," a dealer in Bogota said.

The central bank declined to comment on its operations. Dealers said there was only slight demand from buyers other than the central bank -- mostly out-of-town clients looking to pay letters of credit and send payments abroad.

Limited quantities of coffee export earnings entered the market. Dealers reported 82 trades worth a total $103 million. The peso hit an intraday low of 1,001.47 and closed at its intraday high of 1,001.45.
